controls.name: Access Control Policy
controls.description: Establish and maintain an access control policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, and compliance requirements, including password policies, authentication mechanisms, and access enforcement.
controls.purpose: To ensure proper management of access to information systems and data through comprehensive policies and procedures

controls.name: Account Management
controls.description: Establish procedures for account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal for all information system accounts.
controls.purpose: To manage system accounts effectively throughout their lifecycle

controls.name: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
controls.purpose: To ensure access to resources is strictly controlled

controls.name: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: Control information flows between systems and between interconnected security domains.
controls.purpose: To prevent unauthorized information transfer

controls.name: Separation of Duties
controls.description: Separate duties of individuals to prevent malevolent activity without collusion.
controls.purpose: To reduce the risk of malicious activity through role separation

controls.name: Audit Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain an audit and accountability policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, and requirements.
controls.purpose: To ensure proper auditing of system activities

controls.name: Audit Events
controls.description: Determine and maintain a set of auditable events and specify audit record content.
controls.purpose: To track security-relevant activities and detect violations

controls.name: Configuration Management Policy
controls.description: Establish and maintain a configuration management policy and procedures.
controls.purpose: To ensure consistent system configurations

controls.name: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop and maintain baseline configurations for information systems.
controls.purpose: To provide a reference point for system changes

controls.name: Configuration Change Control
controls.description: Track and control changes to the information system configuration.
controls.purpose: To maintain system integrity through change management

controls.name: Identification and Authentication Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain identification and authentication policies and procedures, including password complexity requirements, password aging, and authentication mechanisms.
controls.purpose: To ensure proper user identification and authentication through strong password policies and authentication methods

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Implement strong authentication mechanisms for all organizational users, including password policies, multi-factor authentication, and other authentication methods as required.
controls.purpose: To ensure secure user authentication through strong password requirements and additional authentication factors

controls.name: Incident Response Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain an incident response policy and procedures.
controls.purpose: To ensure effective response to security incidents

controls.name: Incident Response Training
controls.description: Provide incident response training to system users and administrators.
controls.purpose: To prepare personnel for incident handling

controls.name: Incident Response Testing
controls.description: Test the incident response capability for the information system.
controls.purpose: To validate incident response procedures

controls.name: System and Communications Protection Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain system and communications protection policies.
controls.purpose: To protect system communications

controls.name: Application Partitioning
controls.description: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.
controls.purpose: To reduce attack surface through separation

controls.name: System and Information Integrity Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain system and information integrity policies and procedures.
controls.purpose: To maintain system integrity

controls.name: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information system flaws.
controls.purpose: To address system vulnerabilities promptly

controls.name: Physical and Environmental Protection Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain physical and environmental protection policies.
controls.purpose: To protect physical assets and environment

controls.name: Information Security Policies
controls.description: Provide management direction and support for information security, including policies for access control, authentication, and data protection.
controls.purpose: To ensure management commitment to security and establish comprehensive security policies

controls.name: Internal Organization
controls.description: Establish a management framework for information security implementation.
controls.purpose: To manage information security within the organization

controls.name: Human Resource Security
controls.description: Ensure employees understand responsibilities and are suitable for roles.
controls.purpose: To reduce human-related security risks

controls.name: Asset Management
controls.description: Identify organizational assets and define protection responsibilities.
controls.purpose: To maintain appropriate protection of organizational assets

controls.name: Inventory of Authorized and Unauthorized Devices
controls.description: Actively manage all hardware devices on the network.
controls.purpose: To prevent unauthorized device access

controls.name: Inventory of Authorized and Unauthorized Software
controls.description: Actively manage all software on the network.
controls.purpose: To prevent unauthorized software execution

controls.name: Continuous Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Continuously acquire, assess, and take action on new information.
controls.purpose: To identify and remediate vulnerabilities

controls.name: Controlled Use of Administrative Privileges
controls.description: Track, control, prevent, and correct administrative privileges.
controls.purpose: To prevent privilege abuse

controls.name: Secure Configuration for Hardware and Software
controls.description: Establish and maintain secure configuration of systems, including authentication mechanisms, password policies, and security settings.
controls.purpose: To reduce attack surface through secure configuration and policy enforcement

controls.name: System Maintenance Policy
controls.description: Develop and maintain system maintenance policies and procedures.
controls.purpose: To ensure proper system maintenance

controls.name: Controlled Maintenance
controls.description: Schedule, perform, and document maintenance of information system components.
controls.purpose: To maintain system reliability and security
